title: Drawing Checklist: How to QA/QC a Drawing Set Before It Issues
summary: A drawing checklist for QA/QC before a set issues: what to check on every sheet and in each series, and which checks an AI drawing review can flag first.
body_markdown:
## How Pirros reviews a drawing set


The[Quality Management System](https://www.pirros.com/quality-management-system) , Pirros's AI-powered QA/QC product, runs the first pass of this checklist on the set itself, checking it against the codes selected for the project, the firm's uploaded standards and the references you load, such as the specification and consultant drawings.


Each issue opens on the sheet, zoomed to the condition. It shows the rule it came from, with the exact clause text, the reasoning in plain language, and a record of which sheets, schedules and spec sections were consulted. Every issue carries a severity of high, medium or low, so solving major issues can be prioritized. Reviewers can assign an issue, comment on it, or dismiss it with a reason: not applicable, false positive, already addressed or acknowledged. Dismissals persist across later runs, and the reasons are recorded, so the review history shows what was checked and what was decided. Nothing changes in the set until a person says so.


At[Number TEN Architectural Group](https://www.pirros.com/customers/number-ten-architectural-group) , a review of a set heading to bid against the current building code surfaced sloped glazing and safety glass requirements that had been omitted. The team carried them straight into the specification before the set went out.


For the drawing standards items on every sheet, Mira, Pirros's free[AI agent for Revit](https://www.pirros.com/mira) , can audit a view against your firm's template. It checks line styles, text and dimension styles, hatches, tags and keynotes, applies the certain matches, asks you about the judgment calls and reports anything it skipped.


To learn more about QA/QC directly in the Revit model, see our[Revit QA/QC guide](https://www.pirros.com/blog/qaqc-for-revit-complete-guide) .
